name: Kaiser Permanente San Francisco Half Marathon & 5K
summary: A certified, mostly flat course through Golden Gate Park and out and back on the Great Highway. Registration is on the race's own site.

name: Golden Gate Half Marathon & 5K
summary: Starts near Aquatic Park and crosses the Golden Gate Bridge twice. Packet pickup is October 30 and 31 at Sports Basement Stonestown.

name: Berkeley Half Marathon
summary: Berkeley's biggest race day: half at 7:30 AM, 10K and 5K at 8:30 AM, all from Milvia St at Kittredge St. Online registration runs through October 30 on Race Roster.

name: Napa Valley Marathon & Half
summary: A point-to-point marathon down the Silverado Trail from Calistoga to Napa. Half starts at 7:00 AM, 5K at 7:15 AM and the marathon at 7:30 AM.

name: Oakland Marathon
street: Lake Merritt Blvd (Henry J. Kaiser Center)
summary: A one-loop marathon past Lake Merritt and downtown with an out-and-back on the Bay Bridge. Marathon and half at 7:00 AM, 10K at 8:30 AM, 5K at 9:00 AM.

name: Bay to Breakers
summary: San Francisco's famous costume race from downtown to Ocean Beach. The 15K adds 3K on the Great Highway. Waves start from 8:00 AM and prices rise in steps.

name: The San Francisco Marathon
summary: The 50th running, over the Golden Gate Bridge. The full starts at 5:15 AM on the Embarcadero at Market and has a 6-hour limit.
